items.author: bastardofrealit.bsky.social
items.context: Man, I just wanted to get a basic graphics card so I could play the 20 year old games I got from GOG without any stupid hickups. Any suggestions?
items.text: Most 20-year-old games run fine on any modern graphics card, so hiccups are usually compatibility issues rather than GPU power. Which game is giving you trouble?

items.author: gamerbait.bsky.social
items.context:
StarTropics was one of Nintendo's more unique late NES titles and by then devs were maxing out the hardware. Its box art popped on shelves, but it was a rental trap: a needed code was on a letter in the box, and stores lost it. Did your video store burn you too? Did you beat it? #RetroGaming
4 images, no description
items.text: The letter in the box was a fun gimmick, but a rental nightmare. Hope you beat it in the end.
